name: the-ops-agent-book
description: 面向运维场景的智能体工程手册：规划、设计、建设、维护、优化、迭代

scripts.eval:check: node scripts/generate-eval-cases.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- examples/templates/eval-cases.yaml evidence/synthetic-snapshots.jsonl evidence/snapshot-registry.json
scripts.judge:check: node scripts/generate-judge-candidates.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- evidence/judge-candidates.jsonl evidence/judge-answer-key.jsonl evidence/judge-snapshots.jsonl evidence/judge-candidate-registry.json evidence/judge-snapshot-registry.json && npm run test:judge
scripts.check:all: npm run docs:build && npm run gaps:check && npm run gates:check && npm run refs:check && npm run validate:assets && npm run examples:check && npm run eval:check && npm run judge:check && python3 scripts/check_internal_links.py && npm run check:mermaid && npm run check:responsive && npm run check:accessibility && npm run test:reference && npm run eval:self-test && npm run user-reading:check && npm run test:user-reading && npm run cost:demo && bash -n examples/playbooks/*.sh && python3 -m py_compile examples/playbooks/*.py
